what: Port main #1552 (link only the crates a program code names, as rustc loads them) to v2 live path: hir_ty_codegen::v2 roots.rs/allocator.rs (driven by blaze-cargo serve/unit/codegen.rs) still link every dependency (renamed depended_crates in the merge 2112eaf01f), so unnamed crates constructors, #[used] statics and #[global_allocator] are linked unlike rustc. hir::named_dependencies (ported to v2 in crates/hir/src/named.rs) needs to be reachable from codegen, ideally as a memoised query (hir is only a dev-dependency of hir-ty-codegen). harness/unnamedcrates.py checks it.
